title: Unraveling the genetic enigma of rice submergence tolerance: Shedding light on the role of ethylene response factor-encoding gene SUB1A-1.
authors: Khalil, Md Ibrahim; Hassan, Md Mahmudul; Samanta, Swadesh Chandra; Chowdhury, Abul Kashem; Hassan, Md Zahid; Ahmed, Nasar Uddin; Somaddar, Uzzal; Ghosal, Sharmistha; Robin, Arif Hasan Khan; Nath, Ujjal Kumar; Mostofa, Mohammad Golam; Burritt, David J; Ha, Chien Van; Gupta, Aarti; Tran, Lam-Son Phan; Saha, Gopal
one_liner_zh: 综述水稻耐淹基因SUB1A-1（ERF转录因子）的生理与遗传机制，但无蛋白-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，仅涉及转录因子功能背景，与本课题方法轴和互作轴均不匹配。
abstract: The world's low-lying rice (Oryza sativa) cultivation areas are under threat of submergence or flash flooding due to global warming. Rice plants manifest a variety of physiological and morphological changes to cope with submergence and hypoxia, including lowering carbohydrate consumption, inhibiting shoot elongation, and forming a thicker leaf gas film during submergence. Functional studies have revealed that submergence tolerance in rice is mainly determined by an ethylene response factor (ERF) transcription factor-encoding gene, namely SUBMERGENCE 1A-1 (SUB1A-1) located in the SUB1 quantitative trait locus. The SUB1A-1-dependent submergence tolerance is manifested through hormonal signaling involving ethylene, gibberellic acid, brassinosteroid, auxin and jasmonic acid. Considerable progress has been made toward the introduction of SUB1A-1 into rice varieties through a conventional marker-assisted backcrossing approach. Here, we review the recent advances in the physiological, biochemical and molecular dynamics of rice submergence tolerance mediated by the 'quiescence strategy'. Thus, the present review aims to provide researchers with insights into the genetics of rice submergence tolerance and future perspectives for designing submergence-resilient plants for sustainable agriculture under the uncertainties of climate change.
abstract_zh: 全球低洼地区的水稻（Oryza sativa）种植区正面临因全球变暖导致的淹没或骤发洪水威胁。水稻植株通过多种生理和形态变化来应对淹没和低氧条件，包括降低碳水化合物消耗、抑制茎伸长，以及在淹没期间形成更厚的叶片气体膜。功能研究表明，水稻的耐淹性主要由一个乙烯响应因子（ERF）转录因子编码基因决定，即位于SUB1数量性状位点中的SUBMERGENCE 1A-1（SUB1A-1）基因。SUB1A-1依赖的耐淹性通过涉及乙烯、赤霉素、油菜素内酯、生长素和茉莉酸的激素信号传导得以表现。通过传统的标记辅助回交方法，将SUB1A-1引入水稻品种方面已取得显著进展。本文综述了由“静止策略”介导的水稻耐淹性在生理、生化和分子动力学方面的最新进展。因此，本综述旨在为研究人员提供关于水稻耐淹性遗传学的见解，以及在未来气候变化不确定性下设计耐淹作物以实现可持续农业的前景展望。
